dogecoin.text:
2021 – The Rise of Shiba Inu ($SHIB) 

A new contender entered the ring—$SHIB, dubbed the “#Dogecoin killer.”

Created by an anonymous dev, "#Ryoshi."
Gained traction with a community-driven approach.

Exploded 1,000,000% in under a year.

2020 – The #Elon Effect 

Elon Musk started tweeting about #Dogecoin. 

The internet took notice.

Memes turned into speculation.
Price surged from fractions of a cent to over $0.70 in 2021.

**The moment memecoins became serious money.** https://t.co/0K4NUHX2Oq

2013 – The Birth of the First Memecoin

A joke between two engineers, Billy Markus & Jackson Palmer, led to the creation of Dogecoin ($DOGE).

Inspired by the #Doge meme (Shiba Inu dog with Comic Sans text).

Initially a joke but gained a cult following.
Community-driven and used
